name: icon-chip
description: Icon + label chip (quick-link tile). Composition counterpart of the former control/icon-chip block.
provenPattern: Converted from a block to a composition under the rule 'arrangement-only → template'; the look was ported from the former block component.

knowledge.purpose: Quick-link tile of icon and label
useCases: Quick-access grid on a portal home page
antiPatterns: Leaving an icon without its label — an icon alone is not understood
Picking an icon outside the icon canon
More than eight chips — the grid becomes a scanning load
